bases.label: local alias
bases.why: the calling processor's own Hub: uncached I/O alias of physical 0x01000000 (chips/hub/README.md, Addresses); kudzu docs/interrupts.md [chips 4694fd049578, tools/configs/hub.json]

bases.label: node alias
bases.why: any node's Hub: 0x9200000001800000 plus the node number shifted left 32 (chips/hub/README.md, Addresses); kudzu docs/interrupts.md [chips 4694fd049578, tools/configs/hub.json]

bases.label: bus-error alias
bases.why: a deliberate bus-error generator at physical 0x02400208 (chips/hub/README.md, Addresses) [chips 4694fd049578, tools/configs/hub.json]

bases.label: local alias
bases.why: the calling processor's own node controller: local register r at 0x9200000001000000 + r (docs/datasheets/ip35-address-map.md, Hub register space; chips/bedrock/README.md, Window and how it is reached); kudzu docs/interrupts.md [chips 4694fd049578, tools/configs/bedrock.json]

bases.label: node alias
bases.why: remote register r of node n at 0x9200000001800000 + (n << 33) + r (docs/datasheets/ip35-address-map.md, Hub register space; kudzu docs/interrupts.md, IP35 interrupt section) [chips 4694fd049578, tools/configs/bedrock.json]

bases.label: boot window
bases.why: the Hub special space boot window at special base + 0x18000000, 128 MB (docs/datasheets/ip35-address-map.md, Hub special space); hubspc.o and nic.o hold literals in its first 16 MB (chips/bedrock/README.md, Window and how it is reached) [chips 4694fd049578, tools/configs/bedrock.json]

bases.label: PIU register block

bases.label: widget 15 window

bases.label: widget space (64-bit uncached)

bases.label: widget space (32-bit compatibility)
bases.why: the 32-bit uncached compatibility image of the same widget space (chips/heart/README.md, Addresses: pointers 0xffffffffb7f00000 and 0xffffffffbf000000)

bases.label: special remote window
bases.why: node n's remote register window of the Hub special space, special base + 0x30000000 + (n << 33); the L1 UART registers sit at +0x80 + 8r and the per-processor LEDs at +0xc0 (docs/datasheets/ip35-address-map.md, Hub special space; chips/l1/README.md, Node-local UART)

bases.label: special local window

bases.label: boot window
bases.why: the rest of the 128 MB boot window at special base + 0x18000000 (docs/datasheets/ip35-address-map.md, Hub special space)

scope.reason: video-option-products: DM2 and DIVO video option software, read for the DM2 contract and not part of the base platform. Listed before kernel-other-objects so their platform boot objects leave the in-scope set; their functions are out of scope for now, not excluded.

userland-base: Base user-space daemons and commands of the installed 6.5.30 and 6.5.22 systems: hardware inventory and configuration, the controller and power-management tools, NFS, RPC and CacheFS services, the cluster daemons, the XFS tools and the commands that the open questions name (checkpoint and restart, cpusets and miser, the IP filter daemon, the autofs daemons, the CD-ROM and SCSI control tools). Listed so the inventory counts them; their functions are out of scope for now, not excluded.

userland-libraries: The runtime loader and the shared libraries of the installed 6.5.30 and 6.5.22 systems that the open questions name: the loader in the three ABIs, the C and maths libraries in their MIPS III and MIPS IV builds, the thread, unwinder and C++ support libraries, the X11 and XInput client libraries, the audio library and the libraries of the checkpoint, cpuset, data-placement and counter commands. Listed so the inventory counts them; their functions are out of scope for now, not excluded.

userland-programs: The two X server builds of the 6.5.30 and 6.5.22 media (the generic one an Octane or Onyx2 runs, and the Indigo2 NG1 build) and two commands outside the base directories, the performance-counter and job-limit tools. Listed so the inventory counts them; their functions are out of scope for now, not excluded.
